01_seed_realized_carries.detail: realised carry counts improve downstream CRPS in 4/4 seasons by 50.93% on average. Eligible systems draw the carry count from the accepted P4C allocation and never from the outcome

02_seed_same_game_rushing_yards.detail: blending in this game's own rushing yards improves weighted MSE by 75.00%; p5a_build reads every accumulator BEFORE updating it (True)

03_seed_same_game_ypc.detail: using this game's realised yards per carry improves weighted MSE by 100.00% (it is the target). No shipped feature reads rush_yards or ypc of the row

04_seed_same_game_explosive_run.detail: this game's own explosive-run rate improves weighted MSE by 39.78% (pooled explosive rate 0.1138); the shipped explosive feature is built from prior games only

05_seed_future_player_efficiency.detail: WEAK (50/50 blend with the next four games) makes weighted MSE -3.97% -- it does NOT leak, four games of YPC is too noisy to help. STRONG (the entire future YPC, blend weight fitted, beta=+0.327) improves it by 0.44%. Every accumulator in p5a_build advances strictly in `ord` order

06_seed_future_team_efficiency.detail: the team's FUTURE rushing efficiency improves weighted MSE by 0.87%; the team accumulator is read before the game is added to it

07_seed_future_opponent_outcome.detail: the opponent's FUTURE rushing yards allowed improve weighted MSE by 0.50%; the opponent accumulator is also read before update

10_seed_evaluation_season_fitting.detail: refitting the POOL and the shrinkage constant on 2024 gives k=160 and buys only 0.24% -- that channel is genuinely small, because pooled YPC is 4.29-4.32 across seasons. Refitting the COEFFICIENT on 2024 (beta=+0.685) buys 0.50%. The shipped constants and coefficients are fitted on prior seasons only ({'2022': 80, '2023': 40, '2024': 40, '2025': 80})

13_GUARD_DELETION_history_read_before_up.detail: moving the update above the read raises corr(history, this game's ypc) from 0.1592 to 0.2370 on 1768 rows. The read-then-update ordering in p5a_build.build is the whole chronology guarantee for every player, team and opponent signal
